name: io.github.lx1112/onchaincheck-company-data
title: OnchainCheck Company Data
description: Company enrichment, hiring trends, job postings, email finding, SEC filings. Pay per call (x402)

tools.name: company_enrich
tools.description: Company enrichment from a domain: name, description, logo, founded, headquarters, country, industry, employee count, ticker, founders, CEO and parent (Wikidata), social profiles and contact links (homepage), tech stack, mail provider, domain age, careers page and open job count from ~20,000 indexed job boards. Repeat lookups list what changed since the previous check. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Company enrichment from hiring data: give a company name, website or careers URL and get its job board (ATS and careers page), open roles, top departments, locations and countries, remote share, pay median, newest jobs, and roles opened and closed in the last 7 and 30 days, from a twice-daily crawl of about 20,000 public job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday). Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Company name, website or careers-page URL (openai, stripe.com, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir)

tools.name: company_hiring_trend
tools.description: Company growth signal: is a company growing or cutting? From our recorded history of every posting added and removed on its public job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: open roles now, added and removed per week, net change and growth rate over 7 and 30 days, teams and locations growing or shrinking, new roles, remote share, ATS and careers page, and a one-line summary. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Company name, website or careers-page URL (stripe, openai.com, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir)

tools.name: company_hiring_movers
tools.description: Lead lists from hiring signals: which companies are hiring fastest, or cutting? Ranks companies by job postings added and removed in the last 7, 14 or 30 days, from our recorded history of about 20,000 public job boards crawled twice a day; filter by job function (sales, engineering, data...). Up to 50 companies with company domain when known, ATS and careers page, open roles, added, removed, net change, growth rate and layoff or hiring-freeze signals. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

direction.description: growing ranks by most postings added net; shrinking by most removed net (default growing)

function.description: Rank by one job function's net change, read from job titles (e.g. sales)

minOpen.description: Smallest company to include: open postings at the window's start, 5-5000 (default 10)

staffing.description: Staffing agencies' boards: exclude (default), include, or only

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: Open roles at one company: give a company name, website or board URL and get the jobs open now on its public board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, BambooHR, Personio, Teamtailor, Rippling, Gem, Breezy, Pinpoint), with the ATS it uses and its open-role count. Filter by title, location or remote. Returns the newest 50 matching jobs (title, location, remote flag, salary when shown, apply link). Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Company name (stripe), website (stripe.com) or job-board URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir)

title.description: Keep jobs whose title contains this text; comma-separate alternatives (engineer,developer)

location.description: Keep jobs whose location, country or workplace type contains this text (london, remote)

remote.description: true keeps only jobs marked remote

tools.name: companies_hiring_scan
tools.description: Batch company enrichment from hiring data: give up to 10 company names, websites or job-board URLs, with optional title, location and remote filters. Each company gets its ATS and careers page, open and matching roles, remote share, top teams, the newest matching jobs, and postings added and removed in the last 7 and 30 days with a growing, steady or shrinking signal, from our crawl history of 18,000+ boards. Ranked by matching jobs, with a one-line summary. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

companies.description: Up to 10 company names (stripe), websites (openai.com) or job-board URLs, comma-separated (a JSON array also works)

title.description: Keep jobs whose title contains this text; comma-separate alternatives (engineer,developer)

location.description: Keep jobs whose location or country contains this text (london, remote)

remote.description: true keeps only jobs marked remote

jobsPerCompany.description: Newest matching jobs listed per company, 0 to 10 (default 3)

tools.name: jobs_search
tools.description: Job search: find open jobs (remote, by title, location or pay) across about 20,000 company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: about 470,000 jobs. Filter by title words, company, location, remote, minimum yearly salary and posting age. Returns up to 50 newest matches with company, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and link. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives (data engineer,analytics engineer)

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay, in currency; only jobs that publish pay

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (1-365)

tools.name: jobs_new
tools.description: Job alerts: new job openings since a time, for monitoring (e.g. new remote engineering roles): jobs first seen by a twice-daily crawl of about 20,000 company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday). Same filters as /jobs/search (title, company, location, remote, minimum salary). Returns up to 50 newest, each with when it was first seen, and nextSince for the next poll. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

since.description: ISO 8601 time or Unix seconds; older than 30 days counts as 30 days ago

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay, in currency; only jobs that publish pay

tools.name: jobs_salary
tools.description: Salary for a job title: how much a role pays, from open postings that publish pay, on about 20,000 company job boards crawled twice a day. Optional location, remote and currency. Returns yearly p10/p25/median/p75/p90, the typical posted range, remote vs on-site medians, the five top-paying companies and the posting count. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives (data engineer,analytics engineer)

currency.description: Currency (USD, EUR...); default the commonest among matches

tools.name: email_find
tools.description: Finds a person's likely work email from their name and company domain. Checks the domain's mail servers, reads the company's homepage and contact pages for addresses it publishes to learn its pattern (jane.doe, jdoe, jane), and ranks candidates with a confidence each. An exact address found on the site comes first. No SMTP probe. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

name.description: Person's first and last name (Jane Doe)

tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Is this email address worth sending to? Checks syntax, the domain's mail servers (MX, implicit MX, null MX) and mail provider, disposable domains (10,000+ known), role accounts (info@, sales@), free providers, and misspelled domains (gmial.com suggests gmail.com). Returns valid, risky or invalid with a 0-100 score and reasons. No SMTP probe. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: email_auth_check
tools.description: Check a domain's email authentication: SPF record and its all-mechanism and lookup count, DMARC policy, DKIM at common selectors, MX hosts and mail provider, and BIMI, with plain findings and an A-F grade. Answers whether mail from the domain can be spoofed and whether it is set up to reach inboxes. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: domain_lookup
tools.description: Everything about a domain in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, CNAME), email security graded A-F (mail provider, SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM at common selectors, BIMI, with findings) and RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, age in days, status, nameservers, DNSSEC). Repeat lookups list what changed since the previous check. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: website_tech_stack
tools.description: The technologies a website runs on, from one fetch of the page: CMS, e-commerce platform, frameworks, analytics and tag managers, marketing and chat tools, payments, CDN, hosting and web server, about 85 signatures. Each with its category, plus a by-category summary. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sec_company
tools.description: US public company data from SEC EDGAR by ticker, CIK or name: industry, exchange, address, fiscal year end, recent filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) with links, and latest annual and quarterly revenue, net income, operating income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash and operating cash flow. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sec_8k_events
tools.description: Material corporate events from SEC 8-K filings, market-wide or for one company (ticker, CIK or name): filter by item (1.05 cybersecurity incident, 2.02 earnings, 5.02 executive change, 1.03 bankruptcy, 4.02 restatement... or names like cybersecurity, earnings), dates and words. Each event has company, tickers, filed and event dates, items with descriptions and the filing link. SEC EDGAR public data. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or company name (default: all companies)

item.description: Comma list of 8-K items (1.05, 2.02, 5.02) or names (cybersecurity, earnings, exec-change, bankruptcy, acquisition, restatement)

q.description: Words to search in the filings

since.description: From date (default 7 days back, 1 year for a company)

tools.name: sec_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider trading at a US public company from SEC Form 4 filings: give a ticker, CIK or name. Each insider with role and transactions (open-market buys and sells, awards, option exercises, tax withholding, gifts): shares, price, value, holdings after, 10b5-1 plan flag. Summary: net open-market buying, buyers and sellers, cluster buying, largest trades. Window 1-365 days. Data: SEC EDGAR. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: US ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193) or company name

tools.name: sec_13f_holdings
tools.description: What a fund or institutional manager owns, from its latest SEC 13F-HR filing: give a name (Berkshire Hathaway, Bridgewater) or CIK. Holdings ranked by value with issuer, CUSIP, shares, value and portfolio weight, total value and top-10 concentration, plus changes since the previous quarter: new positions, sold out, added and trimmed with share change. Data: SEC EDGAR. Managers with very large filings (Vanguard, BlackRock) answer 422. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

filer.description: Manager name (Berkshire Hathaway) or SEC CIK (1067983)

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: A mutual fund's or ETF's portfolio from its latest public SEC N-PORT report, by ticker (VFIAX, QQQ, ARKK) or SEC series id: net assets, number of positions, top holdings with value, % of net assets, CUSIP and ISIN, top-10 concentration, and breakdowns by asset class and country. N-PORT is public 60 days after quarter end. SEC EDGAR public data. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

fund.description: Fund or ETF ticker, or SEC series id (S000002839)

tools.name: example_output
tools.description: Free. Shows what a paid tool on this server returns: its price, an example input and the output captured from a real paid call. Tools: company_enrich, company_profile, company_hiring_trend, company_hiring_movers, company_jobs, companies_hiring_scan, jobs_search, jobs_new, jobs_salary, email_find, email_validate, email_auth_check, domain_lookup, website_tech_stack, sec_company, sec_8k_events, sec_insider_trades, sec_13f_holdings, fund_holdings.

tool.description: Name of a paid tool on this server

tools.name: hiring_radar
tools.description: Free. This week's ten companies adding the most job postings and the ten cutting the most, from career-site job boards. The full ranking (up to 50, 7/14/30 days, by job function) is company_hiring_movers (paid).
